initial_prompt: Write a short, evocative poem about the feeling of nostalgia when finding an old, dusty photograph.

messages.content: Write a short, evocative poem about the feeling of nostalgia when finding an old, dusty photograph.

<thinking>
Task Type: Creative Writing (Poem).

I will brainstorm sensory details related to finding an old photograph, such as dust, faded colors, and the sudden rush of memory. Then, I will structure these into a short, evocative poem focusing on the emotional weight of nostalgia and the passage of time.

<verification>
The resulting poem directly addresses the prompt's constraints: it is short, evocative, and centers on the nostalgia evoked by a dusty photograph.
</verification>

A thumb sweeps clear the silvered dust,
Revealing smiles the years unmade,
Where time is caught in paper crust
And vivid moments start to fade.

A sudden ache, a phantom breeze,
A world asleep in monochrome—
The ghost of youth within the crease,
A quiet pull that calls me home.
